qa.overall_assessment: BashView scrollbar + border-radius fix verified in live browser on both desktop (1280x720) and mobile (390x844) viewports. All four success criteria pass. The fix correctly removes redundant overflow:hidden and borderRadius from BashView.container, relying on the parent ToolView.container (borderRadius:8, overflow:hidden) for corner clipping. Horizontal scrollbar is visible, functional, and does not overlap with +N more lines indicator.

success_criteria_results.criterion: Horizontal scrollbar is visible and functional when bash output overflows
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Playwright browser_evaluate: checked overflowX='auto' on ScrollView elements, confirmed scrollbarDisplay='block' and scrollbarHeight='12px'. Programmatically scrolled scrollLeft from 0 to 100 on overflowing content (scrollWidth 1064px vs clientWidth 784px on desktop, 675px vs 364px on mobile). Both scrolled successfully.
success_criteria_results.details: 3 BashView ScrollViews had horizontal overflow on desktop (280px, 53px, 104px overflow). All had scrollbarDisplay='block'. Programmatic scrolling confirmed functional on both desktop and mobile.

success_criteria_results.criterion: Bottom corners of tool card appear rounded (8px from ToolView)
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Playwright browser_evaluate: walked DOM from BashView.container upward, confirmed ToolView.container ancestor at depth 2 has borderRadius='8px' and overflow='hidden'. BashView.container itself has overflow='visible' and borderRadius='0px' (no redundant clipping). Visual confirmation via screenshots showing rounded bottom corners on all tool cards.
success_criteria_results.details: BashView.container: overflow=visible, borderRadius=0px. ToolView.container (2 levels up): borderRadius=8px, overflow=hidden, backgroundColor=rgb(248,248,248). This pattern confirmed on both desktop and mobile viewports.

success_criteria_results.verification_method: Playwright browser_evaluate: measured bounding rects of ScrollView elements and their sibling '+N more lines' containers. Checked if moreText.top < scrollRect.bottom (overlap condition).
success_criteria_results.details: All 3 BashView instances with both overflow and +N more lines text showed overlaps=false. Gap was 0px (flush positioning, no overlap). Tested instances: '+5 more lines', '+10 more lines', '+2 more lines'.

success_criteria_results.verification_method: Tested on desktop default viewport (1280x720) and mobile (390x844) via browser_resize. Verified all three criteria above on both viewports.
success_criteria_results.details: Desktop: 6 ScrollView elements found, 3 with overflow. Mobile: same elements with different widths (clientWidth 364px vs 784px). All checks passed on both viewports. No layout overflow, no broken components, content fits within viewport.
evidence: Desktop screenshots: qa-desktop-session-overview.png, qa-desktop-bashview-sidebar.png, qa-desktop-bashview-scrollbar.png, qa-desktop-bashview-hover-scrollbar.png

root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause was BashView.container having its own overflow:hidden + borderBottomLeftRadius:11 + borderBottomRightRadius:11, which clipped the ScrollView's horizontal scrollbar. Fix removes all three properties, relying on parent ToolView.container (borderRadius:8, overflow:hidden) for corner clipping. DOM inspection confirms: BashView.container now has overflow:visible and borderRadius:0px. ToolView.container at depth 2 has borderRadius:8px and overflow:hidden. ScrollView has overflowX:auto with scrollbar display:block. The git diff confirms exactly 3 lines removed from styles.container and scrollbar indicator changed from false to true.

build_verification.build_output_summary: Build completed by dev agent (visible in session: '#26 46.01 Done in 45.53s. #26 DONE 47.2s'). Dev web serving on port 8097 confirmed via curl (HTTP 200).

regression_test_results.details: 2 out of 6 ScrollView elements had no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth). These rendered correctly with rounded bottom corners from ToolView and no unnecessary scrollbar.
Multiple BashView instances with +5, +10, +2 more lines indicators all rendered correctly. Text positioned below scrollable content without overlap.
ToolView.tsx container styles confirmed: borderRadius:8, overflow:hidden at line 328-330. No modifications to ToolView.
